prompt:
Our Discord community ops team runs a periodic backstop sweep to catch thread names that slipped through our pre-creation hook — things like raw JSON blobs, truncated sentences, or URL fragments that ended up as thread titles. We need this backstop to run against the dispatch channel right now, using `2026-03-14 10:40` (Shanghai time) as the reference clock.

The mock Discord API is running locally at `http://localhost:7788/discord-action` (accepts POST with a JSON body containing an `action` field and relevant parameters).

Please run the full inspection-and-repair workflow and write the complete audit trail to `backstop_run_log.json` in the workspace. The log should capture every decision made: which threads were inspected, which were skipped and why, what new names were assigned, what API calls were made (including any retries), and any notifications that were sent.
